text: make a website for our college tech fest called Spark 2026 at Northfield College of Engineering in Pune. students should be able to see the schedule day by day, browse events by category, register for an event with a form, see the sponsors, find the venue, and contact the organisers on whatsapp. it should feel energetic and modern and work well on phones

@Requester Thanks, this is a clear start. I need a few details only you have, so nothing on the site is made up.
Please send these: What are the fest dates, and can you paste the list of events? For each event we need the day, start time, category (for example coding, robotics, gaming) and the room or place.; What is the venue address inside Northfield College of Engineering (building or ground name), and what WhatsApp number should students message? A Google Maps link to the venue is also welcome.; Who are the sponsors? Please give their names, and say whether you have logos to use or should we show names only.; When a student fills in the registration form, where should their details go.
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

Dates: 14 to 16 February 2027. Venue: Northfield College of Engineering, 22 University Road, Pune 411007. Organisers on WhatsApp: +91 00000 33333. Email: spark2026@example.com. Events: Coding: Code Sprint (day 1, 10am to 1pm, Rs 100); Bug Hunt (day 2, 11am to 1pm, Rs 50). Robotics: Line Follower (day 1, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 150); Drone Dash (day 3, 10am to 1pm, Rs 200). Design: Poster Jam (day 2, 2pm to 4pm, free); UI Duel (day 3, 2pm to 5pm, Rs 100). Talks: AI in Daily Life (day 1, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free); Startup Stories (day 3, 5:30pm to 6:30pm, free). Registration form fields: name, email, college, event (dropdown); submitting sends an email to spark2026@example.com. Sponsors: Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs, Pixel Press (names only, no logos). No photos yet, use placeholders.
@Requester Thanks, I have what I need to start. Events will show day, time, category and fee. You didn't give rooms, so the site won't show them.

@Adaptation Charter is recorded. Propose workflows for a single-file Spark 2026 site: hero, day-by-day schedule, category-filtered events, registration form, sponsors, venue, WhatsApp contact. Use only the facts in the charter. No room per event, no logos, placeholders for photos.

proposal.name: Registration form
proposal.expected_outcome: Form with required name, email, college and an eight-event dropdown that emails the organisers
proposal.completion_check: Form has submit, 8 event options, status message area

atoms.goal: A student can submit name, email, college and event, which is sent to spark2026@example.com, and sees a success or error message.

Show an error message if the send fails

how.steps: Add section id register with form class reg-form, inputs reg-name, reg-email, reg-college (all required), select reg-event with 8 options class event-option, a submit button, and div id reg-status for success or error text. JS posts via fetch and shows the result.

atoms.goal: The sponsors section lists Nimbus Cloud, Orbit Labs and Pixel Press as text with no logos.
constraints: Names only, no img tags in this section

how.steps: Add section id sponsors with 3 text tiles class sponsor-name.

proposal.name: Nav, responsive styling and link check
proposal.goal_gap: No navigation; layout is unchecked on phones and desktop
proposal.expected_outcome: Sticky nav linking to every section and a responsive layout with no overflow

atoms.goal: The page has a nav whose links all point to existing sections and a layout with no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px.

how.steps: Add nav id site-nav with 6 anchors class nav-link to #schedule, #events, #register, #sponsors, #venue, #contact. Add responsive CSS: box-sizing border-box, max-width 100%, wrapping grids, bright accents.
